correctness.rationale: All admissible kernels obey d+1-2 sqrt d by Gram Cauchy–Schwarz and pointwise nonnegative off-diagonal leaf interactions. An explicit even-degree cosine mixture has positive Fourier coefficients, normalized value one, and nonnegative values at every cube vertex. Low weights follow exact Krawtchouk identities; other weights satisfy a uniform O(d^-7/4) Parseval estimate, dominated by the positive O(d^-3/2) shift. The exact one- and two-minus values yield the matching O(1) upper error. The embedded checker reproduces exact rational finite cases without replacing this infinite proof.
